name: Cafe-Konditorei Schreiner
kurzbeschreibung:
**Café-Konditorei Schreiner in Thaur**

Discover the charming **Café-Konditorei Schreiner** in the picturesque village of **Thaur**, just a short drive from **Innsbruck**. This cozy, family-run café and patisserie is a true gem in **Tirol**, offering a delightful blend of traditional Austrian hospitality and exquisite pastries.

Step inside and indulge in their famous **Kaiserschmarrn**, a fluffy, caramelized pancake torn into pieces and dusted with powdered sugar—best enjoyed with a cup of freshly brewed coffee or a glass of **Apfelstrudel** (apple strudel) for dessert. Their selection of **Sachertorte**, **Topfenstrudel**, and **Mohnschnecken** is equally tempting, each bite a testament to the bakery’s craftsmanship.

The café’s rustic yet elegant ambiance, with its warm wooden interiors and flower-adorned tables, makes it the perfect spot for a leisurely breakfast, a midday coffee break, or an afternoon treat. Whether you’re a local or a visitor exploring the stunning **Tiroler Alps**, **Café-Konditorei Schreiner** promises a taste of authentic **Tiroler** tradition in every bite.

Don’t miss their seasonal specialties, like **Vanillekipferl** or **Nusshörnchen**, and pair your dessert with a glass of **Tiroler** wine or a frothy **Eis** (ice cream) from their ever-changing selection. A visit here is more than just a stop—it’s an experience of **Tirol’s** finest culinary delights.
